title: All Video Downloader & Player
summary: HD video downloader & player. Save any video & watch offline in 1 tap
description:
All Video Downloader & Player helps you download videos quickly, save them securely and watch them offline anytime.
Browse websites, detect videos automatically and download HD videos with just one tap. Enjoy a fast video downloader and video saver, smart browser, private video vault, download manager and offline player in one easy-to-use app.

⭐ Fast HD Video Downloader
Download videos in high quality and save them directly to your device for offline viewing.
The app automatically detects downloadable videos while browsing and lets you save them quickly with a simple tap. Enjoy fast and stable downloading with support for multiple video formats.
Whether you want to save videos for offline access or manage your media collection, All Video Downloader & Player makes the process easy and efficient.

🌐 Built-in Browser
Browse websites directly inside the app and discover videos quickly.
The integrated browser helps you search, navigate and find downloadable media without switching between apps. Once a video is detected, you can start downloading immediately.
Designed for convenience, the browser offers a smooth and user-friendly experience.

📥 Powerful Download Manager
Manage all your downloads in one place.
Features include:
• Multiple downloads at the same time
• Pause and resume downloads
• Retry failed downloads
• Background downloading
• Download progress tracking
• Fast and stable performance
Keep your downloads organized and accessible whenever you need them.

🎬 HD Video Quality
Choose the video quality that fits your needs.
Available video qualities:
• HD
• Full HD
• Multiple high-quality formats
Save videos in the resolution you prefer and enjoy smooth offline playback.

▶ Built-in Video Player
Watch downloaded videos anytime without installing an additional player.
The built-in video player supports popular video formats and provides smooth playback directly inside the app.
Enjoy your favorite videos offline wherever you are.

🔒 Private Video Vault
Protect your personal videos with a secure private folder.
Keep important or private content separate from your regular media library and enjoy greater privacy when storing videos on your device.
Your videos remain organized, secure and easy to access.
